passages.title: 會按電梯的狗
passages.text: Our neighbor Mr. Lin lives on the tenth floor with his old dog, Lucky. Lucky is very smart. Every morning, Mr. Lin and Lucky walk to the park. When they come back, Lucky always runs into the {1} first. Then he stands up and pushes the button for the tenth floor with his nose! People who see this always laugh. Last month, Mr. Lin got sick and had to stay in the {2} for a week, so my family took care of Lucky. Every day, I took him downstairs and walked him around the {3} of our building. But Lucky always stopped at the front {4} and looked down the street. He was waiting for Mr. Lin. When Mr. Lin finally came home, Lucky was so {5} that he jumped up and down and barked. Mr. Lin hugged him and said to me, "Thank you for taking care of my best friend."

blanks.why: run into the elevator「跑進電梯」，接著按十樓的按鈕。pumpkin（南瓜）、sweater（毛衣）、cough（咳嗽）都不能跑進去、也沒有按鈕。
stay in the hospital「住院」：林先生生病了。fork（叉子）、sock（襪子）、lemon（檸檬）都不是人能待的地方。
the yard of our building「大樓的中庭／空地」，可以遛狗。throat（喉嚨）、spoon（湯匙）、cookie（餅乾）都不能在周圍散步。
the front gate「前面的大門」：狗停在門口看著街上。soup、tooth、glove 都不是可以站在旁邊望向街道的出入口。
so excited that…「興奮到…」：主人回家，狗跳上跳下。salty（鹹的）、sour（酸的）、spicy（辣的）都是形容味道的字，不能形容狗的心情。

passages.zh: 我們的鄰居林先生和他的老狗 Lucky 住在十樓。Lucky 非常聰明。每天早上，林先生和 Lucky 會走路去公園。回來的時候，Lucky 總是先跑進電梯，然後站起來用鼻子按十樓的按鈕！看到的人都會笑出來。上個月，林先生生病了，得住院一個星期，所以我們家幫忙照顧 Lucky。每天我都帶牠下樓，在大樓的中庭繞一繞。但 Lucky 總是停在前面的大門，望著街上。牠在等林先生。林先生終於回家時，Lucky 興奮得又跳又叫。林先生抱著牠，對我說：「謝謝你照顧我最好的朋友。」

passages.title: 颱風夜的老房子
passages.text: Last summer, a strong typhoon hit Hualien, where my grandparents live. Their old house has a metal {1}, and the rain on it sounded like a thousand drums. Around midnight, water started to drop from the ceiling into the living room. Grandpa quickly brought some buckets and put them on the {2}. Then the wind blew so hard that the {3} of the front yard opened and hit the wall again and again. Grandpa wanted to go out and close it, but Grandma said, "It's too {4}! Stay inside." We sat together and listened to the storm all night. The next morning, the sky was blue again. We walked into the {5} and found leaves and garbage everywhere. Grandpa looked up at the roof and smiled. "This old house is stronger than it looks," he said.

blanks.why: a metal roof「鐵皮屋頂」：雨打在上面像鼓聲。knife（刀子）、cough（咳嗽）、sock（襪子）都不是房子的一部分。
put the buckets on the floor「把水桶放在地上」接漏水。soup、lip、candy 都不能放水桶在上面。
the gate of the front yard「前院的大門」被風吹開、一直撞牆。tooth、spoon、cookie 都不會被風吹開又撞牆。
too dangerous「太危險」：颱風天出去很危險。sweet、salty、yummy 都是形容食物味道的字。
walk into the yard「走進院子」，看到滿地落葉和垃圾。throat、fork、lemon 都不能走進去。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，一個強颱侵襲我外公外婆住的花蓮。他們的老房子是鐵皮屋頂，雨打在上面就像一千面鼓在響。半夜左右，水開始從天花板滴到客廳裡。外公趕緊拿了幾個水桶放在地上。接著風大到把前院的大門吹開，一次又一次地撞到牆上。外公想出去把門關上，但外婆說：「太危險了！待在屋裡。」我們整晚坐在一起聽著暴風雨。隔天早上，天空又變藍了。我們走進院子，發現到處都是落葉和垃圾。外公抬頭看看屋頂，笑著說：「這間老房子比看起來還堅固呢。」

passages.title: 在院子裡露營
passages.text: My parents promised to take us camping, but it rained every weekend for a month. My little sister was very {1}. Then one sunny Saturday, Dad had an idea. "Let's camp in our own {2} tonight!" he said. He put up a small tent under the big tree next to Mom's vegetable {3}. Mom made hot chocolate, and we played cards with a flashlight. When it got dark, we turned off all the lights in the house, and everything became {4}. We could hear frogs singing near the vegetables, and we saw a few stars over the {5} of our neighbor's house. At midnight, it started to rain again! We all ran back inside, wet and laughing. The next morning, my sister said, "That was the best camping trip ever, and we didn't even need a car!"

blanks.why: be disappointed「很失望」：一直下雨不能去露營。spicy、juicy、yummy 都是形容食物的字，不能形容心情。
camp in our own yard「在自己家的院子露營」。spoon、tooth、soup 都不能在裡面露營。
vegetable garden「菜園」。cough、glove、throat 都不能和 vegetable 組成「種菜的地方」。
become quiet「變安靜」：燈都關了，四周靜悄悄。salty、sour、spicy 都是味道，不能形容四周。
the roof of our neighbor's house「鄰居家的屋頂」，星星在屋頂上方。fork、lip、bowl 都不是房子的一部分。

passages.zh: 爸媽答應要帶我們去露營，但整整一個月每個週末都在下雨。妹妹非常失望。後來，有一個晴朗的星期六，爸爸想到一個點子。「我們今晚就在自己家的院子露營吧！」他說。他在媽媽菜園旁的大樹下搭了一頂小帳篷。媽媽泡了熱可可，我們用手電筒照著玩撲克牌。天黑以後，我們把屋裡的燈全關掉，一切都變得好安靜。我們聽得到青蛙在菜旁邊唱歌，還看到鄰居家屋頂上方的幾顆星星。半夜，又開始下雨了！我們全都跑回屋裡，渾身濕透卻笑個不停。隔天早上，妹妹說：「這是最棒的一次露營，而且我們連車都不用開！」

passages.title: 魔法花園的守門烏龜
passages.text: Long ago, there was a magic {1} behind a tall stone wall. Its flowers could sing, and its apples tasted like candy. In the middle of it stood a tiny house with a {2} made of flowers. An old turtle named Tobi guarded the golden {3} in the wall. He only opened it for people who could answer his question: "What is more valuable than gold?" One day, a rich prince came. "Diamonds!" he answered. Tobi shook his head, and the prince went home angry. Next, a poor girl came with her little brother on her back. "Family and kindness," she said. Tobi smiled and opened the gate. The girl and her brother {4} the garden all afternoon. They listened to the flowers and ate the sweet apples. Before they left, Tobi gave the girl the golden key. Since that day, she has been the new {5} of the magic garden.

blanks.why: a magic garden「魔法花園」：裡面有會唱歌的花和蘋果樹。spoon、cough、sock 都不能種花、也不會在石牆後面。
a house with a roof made of flowers「屋頂是花做的房子」。throat、fever、cough 都不是房子的一部分。
the golden gate in the wall「牆上的金色大門」，烏龜負責看守、後面也說 opened the gate。tooth、soup、knee 都不能開關。
explore the garden「探索花園」。boiled（煮）、fried（炸）、spelled（拼字）都不能用在花園上。
the owner of the garden「花園的主人」：烏龜把鑰匙給她。cough、spoon、soup 都不能當主人。

passages.zh: 很久以前，一道高高的石牆後面有一座魔法花園。園裡的花會唱歌，蘋果吃起來像糖果。花園中間有一間小屋，屋頂是用花做的。一隻叫 Tobi 的老烏龜看守著牆上的金色大門。只有能回答他問題的人，他才會開門，問題是：「什麼比黃金更珍貴？」有一天，一位有錢的王子來了。「鑽石！」他回答。Tobi 搖搖頭，王子只好生氣地回家。接著，一個窮人家的女孩背著弟弟來了。「家人和善良。」她說。Tobi 笑了，打開了大門。女孩和弟弟整個下午都在探索花園，聽花唱歌、吃甜甜的蘋果。他們離開前，Tobi 把金鑰匙交給女孩。從那天起，她就成了魔法花園的新主人。

passages.title: 沒有四樓的電梯
passages.text: My cousin Emma came from Canada to visit us in Taipei. We live in a tall apartment building. When we got into the {1}, Emma looked at the buttons and was {2}. "There is no fourth floor!" she said. I explained that the number four sounds like the word for "death" in Chinese, so many buildings in Taiwan {3} using it. Emma thought it was very interesting. Then we went up to the {4} of the building, where my grandma grows vegetables in big pots. From up there, we could see Taipei 101. Later, we walked down to the small {5} next to the front gate and sat on a bench. Emma laughed and said, "Now I remember! Some buildings in Canada don't have a thirteenth floor. People are the same everywhere!"

blanks.why: get into the elevator「進電梯」，看到樓層按鈕。pumpkin、wallet、cough 都不能走進去、也沒有按鈕。
be surprised「很驚訝」：發現沒有四樓。salty、yummy、spicy 都是形容食物的字，不能形容人的感受。
avoid + V-ing「避免做…」：避免使用「四」。boil、fry、spell 都不能接 using it 表達「不用某個數字」。
the roof of the building「大樓的頂樓」，奶奶在那裡種菜、看得到 101。spoon、tooth、cookie 都不能爬上去。
a small garden next to the front gate「大門旁的小花園」，可以坐在長椅上。cough、fever、sock 都不能放長椅。

passages.zh: 我的表姊 Emma 從加拿大來台北找我們。我們住在一棟很高的公寓大樓。我們進電梯時，Emma 看著按鈕很驚訝。「沒有四樓耶！」她說。我解釋說，「四」在中文裡聽起來像「死」，所以台灣很多大樓都避免用這個數字。Emma 覺得很有趣。接著我們上到大樓的頂樓，奶奶在那裡用大盆子種菜。從上面可以看到台北 101。後來，我們走到大門旁的小花園，坐在長椅上。Emma 笑著說：「我想起來了！加拿大有些大樓也沒有十三樓。各地的人其實都一樣嘛！」

passages.title: 校門口的導護媽媽
passages.text: Every morning at seven thirty, Mrs. Chen stands at the school {1} in a yellow vest. She helps students {2} the busy street safely. She knows almost every student's name, and she always says, "Good morning! Have a nice day!" When it rains, she holds a big {3} over the little kids. Last month, our class decided to thank her. We planted sunflowers in the small {4} next to the gate and made a big card for her. On Friday morning, we gave her the card. When she read it, there were tears in her eyes. "I have done this job for ten years," she said. "This is the best gift I've ever received." Now every morning, the sunflowers smile at her, and students walk past them into the school {5} with big smiles too.

blanks.why: the school gate「校門」：導護媽媽站在校門口。bowl、cough、sock 都不能讓人站在門口。
help students cross the street「幫學生過馬路」。fry、boil、spell 都不能接 the street 表示過馬路。
hold an umbrella over the kids「替小朋友撐傘」：下雨時。spoon、lemon、toe 都不能擋雨。
plant sunflowers in the garden「在花園種向日葵」。cough、throat、fever 都不能種花。
walk into the school yard「走進校園空地／操場」。tooth、soup、glove 都不能走進去。

passages.zh: 每天早上七點半，陳媽媽都穿著黃色背心站在校門口。她幫學生安全地穿越繁忙的馬路。她幾乎知道每個學生的名字，總是說：「早安！祝你有美好的一天！」下雨的時候，她會替小朋友撐一把大傘。上個月，我們班決定要感謝她。我們在校門旁的小花園種了向日葵，還做了一張大卡片給她。星期五早上，我們把卡片交給她。她讀卡片時，眼眶裡含著淚水。「我做這份工作十年了，」她說，「這是我收過最棒的禮物。」現在每天早上，向日葵都對她微笑，學生們也帶著大大的笑容走過花旁，進入校園。

passages.title: 阿公的大西瓜
passages.text: My grandpa lives in a farmhouse in Yunlin. Behind the house, there is a big {1} where he grows watermelons. Last summer, he grew the biggest watermelon in the village, and he wanted to {2} it in the village watermelon contest. The night before the contest, Grandpa heard a strange noise. He looked out the window and saw a monkey climbing over the {3}! The monkey ran to the watermelons, picked up a small one, and climbed up to the {4} of the house. It sat there and ate the watermelon happily. Grandpa just laughed and went back to bed. "Little thief, you have good taste," he said. Luckily, the monkey didn't touch the big one. The next day, Grandpa's watermelon won first {5}. Now there is a new sign in the yard: "Monkeys welcome. Please don't eat the big ones!"

blanks.why: a big yard where he grows watermelons「種西瓜的大院子」。sock、cough、bowl 都不能種西瓜。
enter it in the contest「拿去參加比賽」，enter 有「報名參加」的意思。fry、boil、spell 都不能接 in the contest。
climb over the gate「爬過大門」：猴子闖進來。soup、fever、tooth 都不能爬過去。
climb up to the roof「爬上屋頂」，坐在上面吃西瓜。spoon、throat、cookie 都不能讓猴子坐在上面。
win first prize「得到第一名」。cough、sock、toe 都不能和 first 組成「第一名」。

passages.zh: 我阿公住在雲林的一間農舍。房子後面有一個大院子，他在那裡種西瓜。去年夏天，他種出了全村最大的西瓜，想拿去參加村裡的西瓜比賽。比賽前一晚，阿公聽到奇怪的聲音。他往窗外一看，看到一隻猴子正爬過大門！猴子跑到西瓜那裡，抱起一顆小的，爬上了房子的屋頂，坐在那裡開心地吃了起來。阿公只是笑一笑，回去睡覺。「小偷，你還真會挑。」他說。幸好猴子沒碰那顆大的。隔天，阿公的西瓜得了第一名。現在院子裡多了一塊新牌子：「歡迎猴子，但請不要吃大顆的！」

passages.title: 台北 101 的超快電梯
passages.text: Last week, our class took a field trip to Taipei 101. Our guide told us that its {1} is one of the fastest in the world. It can go from the fifth floor to the eighty-ninth floor in about thirty-seven seconds! When the doors closed, I held my friend's hand. My ears felt strange, but the ride was over very quickly. When the doors opened, we were all {2} and ran to the windows. From up there, we could see the {3} of thousands of buildings. Down on the ground, the parks and {4} looked like tiny green stamps. The guide also showed us a huge golden ball. "It helps the building stay safe during typhoons and earthquakes," she said. Before we left, I bought a small {5} for my mom: a key ring shaped like Taipei 101.

blanks.why: its elevator「它的電梯」：從五樓到八十九樓只要三十七秒。pumpkin、cough、sock 都不能載人上樓。
be excited「很興奮」：門一開就衝去窗邊。salty、sour、spicy 都是味道，不能形容心情。
the roofs of buildings「大樓的屋頂」：從高處往下看到的。soups、coughs、toes 都不是建築物的一部分。
parks and gardens「公園和花園」，看起來像綠色小郵票。fevers、throats、forks 都不是綠色的地面。
buy a gift for my mom「買禮物給媽媽」：一個 101 造型的鑰匙圈。cough、fever、toe 都不能買來送人。

passages.zh: 上星期，我們班到台北 101 校外教學。導覽員告訴我們，這裡的電梯是全世界最快的電梯之一，從五樓到八十九樓只要大約三十七秒！門關上時，我握住朋友的手。我的耳朵怪怪的，不過一下子就到了。門一打開，我們都很興奮地衝到窗邊。從上面可以看到成千上萬棟建築物的屋頂。地面上的公園和花園，看起來像一張張綠色的小郵票。導覽員還帶我們看一顆巨大的金色球。「颱風和地震的時候，它能讓大樓保持安全。」她說。離開前，我買了一個小禮物給媽媽：一個台北 101 造型的鑰匙圈。

passages.title: 想當蜘蛛人的弟弟
passages.text: My little brother Leo loves Spider-Man. He wears a red and blue {1} every day, even at the dinner table. Last Sunday, Mom heard a noise outside. She looked out the window and saw Leo standing on the {2} of the doghouse! Our dog, Coco, was looking up at him. Then Leo jumped down and tried to climb over the {3} of our {4}. Mom ran out and caught him just in time. "Leo, Spider-Man can climb walls, but you can't. You have to be {5}!" she said. Leo was sad. That night, Dad sat next to him and said, "Do you know what makes Spider-Man a hero? It's not climbing. It's helping people." The next day, Leo helped Grandma carry her bags and helped Coco find her ball. "See? I'm still Spider-Man," he said proudly, "but on the ground."

blanks.why: wear a mask「戴面罩」：蜘蛛人的紅藍面罩。spoon、lemon、bowl 都不是可以戴在臉上的東西。
the roof of the doghouse「狗屋的屋頂」：弟弟站在上面。soup、cough、tooth 都不能站上去。
climb over the gate「爬過大門」。fever、spoon、cookie 都不能爬。
the gate of our yard「我們家院子的大門」。throat、sock、candy 都沒有大門。
be careful「要小心」：媽媽提醒他。salty、juicy、sour 都是形容食物的字。

passages.zh: 我弟弟 Leo 超愛蜘蛛人。他每天都戴著紅藍色的面罩，連吃晚餐時也戴。上星期天，媽媽聽到外面有聲音。她往窗外一看，看到 Leo 站在狗屋的屋頂上！我們家的狗 Coco 正抬頭看著他。接著 Leo 跳下來，想爬過我們家院子的大門。媽媽跑出去，及時抓住了他。「Leo，蜘蛛人會爬牆，但你不會。你一定要小心！」她說。Leo 很難過。那天晚上，爸爸坐在他旁邊說：「你知道蜘蛛人為什麼是英雄嗎？不是因為他會爬牆，而是因為他會幫助別人。」隔天，Leo 幫奶奶提袋子，還幫 Coco 找到牠的球。「你看！我還是蜘蛛人，」他驕傲地說，「只是在地面上而已。」

passages.title: 英國筆友的刺蝟
passages.text: Dear Mei, Guess what! Last night, I found a hedgehog in our back {1}. In the UK, we call the place behind our house a "garden," even if it only has grass. My American friend calls it a "{2}." Hedgehogs are small animals with lots of sharp spines, and they come out at night to look for food. I put some cat food and water on a small {3} for it. It ate everything! Dad says hedgehogs need to travel between gardens to find food, so he made a small hole at the bottom of our {4}. Now the hedgehog can come and go. Many people in my town do this, and they call it a "hedgehog highway." I named the hedgehog Spike. It's so {5} when it walks! Do you have hedgehogs in Taiwan? Your friend, Amy

blanks.why: back garden「後院」：英國人把房子後面的空地叫 garden。cough、fever、throat 都不能在裡面找到刺蝟。
call it a yard：美國人把同樣的地方叫 yard「院子」。spoon、sock、soup 都不是房子後面的地方。
put food on a plate「把食物放在盤子上」。cough、fever、knee 都不能裝食物。
a hole at the bottom of our gate「在大門下方挖個洞」，讓刺蝟進出。tooth、lemon、glove 都不是院子的出入口。
so cute「好可愛」：刺蝟走路的樣子。salty、sour、spicy 都是味道，不能形容動物走路。

passages.zh: 親愛的小美：猜猜看！昨晚我在我們家後院發現了一隻刺蝟。在英國，我們把房子後面的地方叫做 garden，即使那裡只有草地。我的美國朋友則叫它 yard。刺蝟是身上有很多尖刺的小動物，晚上才出來找食物。我放了一些貓食和水在小盤子上給牠，牠全部吃光了！爸爸說刺蝟需要在各家的院子之間移動找食物，所以他在我們家大門的下方挖了一個小洞，現在刺蝟可以自由進出了。我們鎮上很多人都這麼做，他們把它叫做「刺蝟公路」。我把這隻刺蝟取名叫 Spike。牠走路的樣子好可愛！台灣有刺蝟嗎？你的朋友 Amy
